alt: 小組搭建橋梁模型時，一名學生剪斷支撐線，讓大家共同完成的部分垂落。
scene_prompt: Modern school project: students cooperate calmly building a cardboard bridge; one student deliberately cuts a load-bearing string, causing only that section of model to sag while others look concerned and teacher addresses the behavior. No real danger, clearly show one troublemaker harming the group's work. Natural anatomy, correct scissors grip, plausible model support.
style_prompt: Children's educational picture-book illustration, pencil outlines, soft watercolor, colored-pencil grain, ivory textured paper, muted natural palette, landscape 3:2. No readable text or logos.
